text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list: You seem calmer than usual, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... yes. In fact, I'm practically 
itching to run... W-Why is that, I 
wonder...?
choice_data_list:
It's a sign of the confidence you've built 
up over time.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
C-Confidence? I wonder if I even have 
something like that...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...B-But... I do believe I've done 
everything I possibly could, so..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
......Y-Yeah. I'll do it. I-I'll... Even I 
can—!
